text:
sam: Heads-up — scheduling v2 rollout to gateway-prod during tonight's change window (02:00-03:00 UTC). Plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m observation at each step. Please ack if you have client concerns.

deploy-bot: [deploy] starting canary: service=gateway-prod target=v2 variant=stable percent=5 initiator=@sam

jin: ack. quick note: mobile SDK v1 still sends `X-Client-Api: v1` header. v2 normalizes to `x-client-api: 2` (lowercase). Some older proxies are strict.

priya: thanks — we should pin mobile client to accept both headers for at least 48h. I can push a compatibility header check in the gateway shim.

alex: seeing a small blip on canary logs, ~3% 5xx at +3m. stacktrace points to header parsing in request-router.

```
ERROR: UnknownHeaderException: header X-Client-Api not found
 at request-router/src/headers.go:42
```

maria: tagging @mobile: can we confirm rollout position for the iOS/Android SDKs? do we have quick patch for v1 that normalizes header case?

tyler: mobile team: we can ship a tiny patch to normalize header to both `X-Client-Api` and `x-client-api` within 2 hours, but it won't reach all users immediately. Suggest we pause automated progression and require a header-compat gate.

sam: proposal: pause at 5% canary, enable a header compatibility toggle that maps incoming headers to the new canonical key, then resume to 25% after 30m observation. If errors persist >1% 5xx over 10m, rollback to v1 across gateway-prod. Does everyone agree?

jin: +1 for pause and compatibility toggle. I'll prepare the patch and a rollout playbook.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary paused: service=gateway-prod variant=v2 reason="manual pause by @sam"

priya: added a safe header shim feature-flag `compat_hdr_v1_v2` (false -> true). It's off in prod. I can enable in the canary pool only. Enabling now on canary nodes.

maria: enabling check in release notes: "Gateway: temporary header compatibility enabled for v2 canary to support legacy mobile SDKs. This will be deprecated in 48 hours." Please add to the release-notes.md.

alex: after shim enable, 5xx dropped to 0.6% at +18m. latency unchanged. Looks good.

tyler: mobile team will fast-track the SDK normalization PR, but we still need pin instructions for platform clients to avoid surprises. I'll post a short note to ops and partners channel.

sam: OK — resume to 25% in 10m and monitor. Rollback trigger: sustained >1% 5xx or >10% error spike vs baseline in 10m. Rollback plan: deploy-bot will redeploy v1 variant and we will revert the header shim flag.

deploy-bot: [deploy] progressing: service=gateway-prod variant=v2 target_percent=25 initiated_by=@sam

jin: monitoring dashboards: will alert on error-rate and client-compat missing header count. setting up a PagerDuty escalation if threshold crossed.

maria: added release-notes entry and updated the product-change log. tagging @growth for customer comms.

sam: thanks all. keep messages here for any rollbacks or odd client reports. once we hit 100% we'll post final notes and deprecate the shim after 48h. :thumbsup:
